description: Use this when someone wants to start planning their own trip to a destination in WonderKit. Returns one guest-planner link with the city (and vibe) filled in, plus a one-line description. It creates nothing and cannot book; the person adds dates and travelers in the planner. The link is a planner, not a citable guide page.

city.description: Destination as the person said it, such as "Lisbon" or "Asheville, NC". Any city works.

endDate.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, if they gave one.

kidsAges.description: Ages of children travelling, if any.

startDate.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, if they gave one.

vibe.description: The feel they want, if they said.

name: plan_trip_link

description.description: One line saying what the link opens

url.description: Guest planner link to give the person

title: Plan trip link
